description:
Starts runs that spend money from your wallet: people test your website for pay, the first run within about ten minutes, later runs on your cadence with no further call.
Use for: paid human testing of a website. Each run takes costPerRun from your wallet; up to periodCap a month. With an idempotencyKey, within 24 hours the same key returns the first template and ignores new input. After 24 hours or without a key, a repeat saves a second template; both run and charge.
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: create_qa_run_template({"name":"Checkout smoke test","targetUrl":"https://shop.example.com/checkout","instructions":"Buy the cheapest plan with the test card and report every error you hit, with steps.","cadence":"weekly","testerCount":2,"payPerTester":{"amount":2000,"currency":"usd"},"budgetPerRun":{"amount":4720,"currency":"usd"},"periodCap":{"amount":23600,"currency":"usd"},"submissionMode":"video"})
Repeat: A repeat may act again on the thing as it stands then. Read it first.
Errors: account_setup_required, create_in_progress; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

allowedCountries.description: Two-letter country codes testers may be in. Default: any.

applicantScreening.description: What an applicant must give: a live camera video, a LinkedIn profile, a PDF, DOCX or TXT resume. Each defaults to false.

autoMode.description: Default true: we hire and review every tester, remove poor work and pay good work. false asks you for every hiring and pay decision.

budgetPerRun.description: A ceiling per run, $1 to $5,000. It must cover payPerTester plus the 18% fee (rounded to the cent) times testerCount. A run takes costPerRun, not this.

cadence.description: How often a run starts. once runs one time; the others repeat with no further call.

cadenceDays.description: Days between runs, 1 to 30. Required for custom, refused for any other cadence.

checklist.description: Steps every tester must cover; each becomes a point their work is graded on.

id.description: A lowercase id, unique in the list. Left out, one is made from the title.

instructions.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long

media.description: an array of at most 4 item(s)

caption.description: a string at most 200 character(s) long

url.description: An upload under qa-templates/ in our own storage: an https firebasestorage.googleapis.com or storage.googleapis.com link. Any other link is refused.

title.description: a string at most 120 character(s) long

idempotencyKey.description: A unique string for this call. Repeat it when you retry, so the call runs once.

instructionMedia.description: Screenshots or short clips shown with the instructions.

caption.description: a string at most 200 character(s) long

url.description: An upload under qa-templates/ in our own storage: an https firebasestorage.googleapis.com or storage.googleapis.com link. Any other link is refused.

name.description: a string at most 120 character(s) long

payPerTester.description: What each tester gets, $1 to $5,000. Our 18% fee is added on top.

periodCap.description: Monthly spending ceiling, at least budgetPerRun; equal to it for once. Recurring runs need monthly coverage, capped at $50,000; an error gives the minimum.

requiredCredentials.description: Skills or experience an applicant must show.

items.description: a string at most 200 character(s) long

targetUrl.description: The website to test, http or https. It is checked when saved: when it cannot be reached, the template is saved paused.

testerStartMessage.description: Sent privately to each tester once hired, for example test sign-in details.

name: create_qa_run_template

costPerRun.description: What each run takes from your wallet when it starts: testerCount times (payPerTester plus the 18% fee, rounded to the cent).

nextRunAt.description: When the first run is due; it starts within about ten minutes of this time.

pausedReason.description: Why it is paused: the website could not be reached when saved. Nothing will run or be charged; make the site reachable and create a new template. Left out when active.

status.description: paused: saved, but no run starts. It still counts as a success.

walletIsShortBy.description: How much your wallet lacked for costPerRun when the template was saved. A run your wallet cannot cover waits for funds until the next run is due. Left out when the wallet covered it.

title: Start paid website test runs
